{{Top}} {{Droid |type=Corporate |image=[[File:OOM9SortOfCommanding-TPM.jpg]] |name=OOM-9 |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[32 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' [[Naboo]]''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' |creator= |manufacturer=[[Baktoid Combat Automata]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' |line=[[B1-series battle droid]] |model=[[OOM command battle droid]] |class=[[Battle droid]]{{Film|I}} |cost= |length= |width= |height=1.91 [[meter]]s{{EncyclopediaCite|Battle Droids and Other Droids of War}} |mass= |gender= |pronouns=He/him{{ForceCollection|OOM-9|star=3}} |sensor=[[Color|Black]] |plating= |armament= |equipment=[[Electrobinoculars]] |affiliation=*[[Trade Federation]] **[[Trade Federation Droid Army]] }} {{Quote|Open fire!|OOM-9|}} '''OOM-9''' was an [[OOM command battle droid]] who served as the [[commanding officer]] of the [[Trade Federation]]'s [[Trade Federation Droid Army|droid army]] during their [[Invasion of Naboo|invasion]] of the [[planet]] [[Naboo]] in [[32 BBY]]. After [[Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi|apprentice]] returned from [[Coruscant]] with [[Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Amidala]] and gained the help of the [[Gungan Grand Army]], OOM-9 was sent, with the Federation's [[battle droid]] [[army]] to destroy the [[gungan]]s. OOM-9 was the primary contact to convey orders from Trade Federation leaders [[Nute Gunray]] and [[Rune Haako]] to the ground forces. He oversaw the battle while inside his own personal [[Armored Assault Tank Mk I|Armored Assault Tank]], ordering forces to overrun settlements and prevent the population from reporting the invasion by destroying communications transmitters.''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' The [[droid]]s were able to create a victory for the Federation, but this was short-lived, as every Federation battle droid was shut down when [[Anakin Skywalker]] destroyed the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|Droid Control Ship]] above [[Naboo]]. The control ship's destruction affected OOM-9, as it rendered the droid commander temporarily inactive. ==Biography== ===Construction of the Droid Army=== [[File:OOM9OpenFire-TPM.png|thumb|left|300px|Constructed by Baktoid Combat Automata, OOM-9 served as the commanding officer of the Trade Federation Droid Army.]] Constructed by [[Baktoid Combat Automata]], OOM-9 was an [[OOM command battle droid]] of the [[B1-series battle droid]] [[B-series battle droid|line]], who held the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[commander]] within the [[Trade Federation]]'s private [[Trade Federation Droid Army|droid army]]. When the manufacturing company began its production of [[battle droid]]s on request of the Federation, Baktoid was forced to resolve the issues proposed by their employer to construct battle [[droid]]s with the inability to operate independently. As such, the requirement forced the droids' dependence on a [[Central Control Computer]] located aboard a [[starship]] in [[planet]]ary [[orbit]]. Therefore, in order for the Federation to relay commands and transmissions to their droid [[Army|armies]] on the surface, it became essential for the manufacturing company to produce a series of command battle droids, of which OOM-9 was constructed as the most successful of the produced units. Maintaining a record not particularly distinguished, OOM-9 operated within the Federation army as more than a simple [[squadron]] commander, having received a promotion to the commander [[general]] for the organization's droid armies during his service to the Federation. In spite of his unremarkable reputation, the droid was selected via digital frequency by the droid control computer. From that point onward, OOM-9 became the primary contact for Federation [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray]] and other commanders of the organization's private [[Trade Federation military|military forces]]. ===Blockade of Naboo=== {{Dialogue|OOM-9|Yes, Viceroy?|Rune Haako|Captain, we've searched the ship and there is no trace of the Jedi. They may have gotten on one of your landing craft.|OOM-9|If they're down here, sir, we'll find them.|Nute Gunray|Use caution. These Jedi are not to be underestimated.|attr=Gunray and Haako, alerting OOM-9 to the Jedi's presence among his forces|src=}} [[File:OOMNineOrders.jpg|thumb|right|300px|OOM-9 is alerted to the Jedi's escape by Nute Gunray and Rune Haako.]] Later, in [[32 BBY]], OOM-9 took part in the Federation's, under the leadership of [[Viceroy]] Gunray, planetary-wide [[blockade]] of the [[Mid Rim Territories]] world of [[Naboo]], which served as a protest to the issuance of [[Prop 31-814D]] by the [[Galactic Republic]].''[[Rise of the Separatists]]'' Sometime during the [[blockade]], transported by a [[Trade Federation fleet|fleet]] of [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|''Lucrehulk''-class Battleships]],''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]'' [[warship]]s that were illegally modified from the organization's [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter|''Lucrehulk''-class LH-3210 cargo freighters]], OOM-9 received special programming to serve as one of several command [[battle droid]]s during the approaching invasion of Naboo. However, following the seventh [[Standard day|day]]''[[Queen's Peril]]'' of the [[Standard week|week]]-long blockade,''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' after the dispatchment of [[Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] from the [[Jedi Order]] as the [[ambassador]]s of [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]], in an effort to negotiate the blockade's ending, Viceroy Gunray contacted his secret ally, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Sidious]], regarding the situation. Sidious proceeded to order the [[Neimoidian]] to accelerate their plan's execution and deploy his [[droid]] forces to the surface under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of OOM-9, who was promoted to the invasion's commanding [[officer]] and served as Gunray and Haako's primary contact for assignments during the invasion, while also ordering him to [[Death|kill]] the Jedi. With the army deployed to the surface, the Jedi were able to evade their demise by boarding some of the droid commander's many [[C-9979 landing craft]], which carried the Federation's thousands of battle droids to the protection of the planet's [[forest]]s, where they were landed safely away from populated centers. Discovering the Jedi's escape from the ''Lucrehulk''-class LH-3210 cargo [[freighter]] [[flagship]] ''[[Saak'ak]]'', Gunray and Haako contacted OOM-9 on the surface and alerted him to the Jedi's presence among his forces, warning him that they may have boarded his [[landing craft]] and to not underestimate them. Assuring that his forces would locate the missing Jedi, OOM-9 proceeded with his invasion as he dispatched battle droids, droidekas, and [[pilot]]s to occupy Naboo settlements and destroy their communication [[transmitter]]s, to prevent the inhabitants from reporting the Federation's illegal movements or requesting aid. With the loss of communications, the droid commander personally led the army to the [[capital]] [[city]] of [[Theed]], the location of Naboo [[Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], with orders to capture the young [[Monarch of Naboo|monarch]] and force the signing of the Federation's treaty and legalize the invasion. ===Capturing Theed=== {{Quote|Viceroy, we have captured the queen.''"
"''Ah, victory.|OOM-9, reporting to Gunray|}} [[File:QueenCaptured.png|thumb|left|300px|OOM-9, reporting Queen Amidala's capture to Gunray.]] With the loss of communications, the droid commander personally led the army to the [[capital]] [[city]] of [[Theed]], the location of Naboo [[Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], with orders to capture the young [[Monarch of Naboo|monarch]] and force the signing of the Federation's treaty and legalize the invasion. As his forces arrived within the city, Amidala observed from the [[Theed Royal Palace]] as OOM-9's battle droids and [[Armored Assault Tank Mk I]]s stopped directly outside her palace. Shortly after his arrival, the droid commander and his droids proved successful in their capture of Queen Amidala and reported his successes to Viceroy Gunray and Haako upon their arrival on the surface in the [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]] ''[[Lapiz Cutter]]''.{{BuildFalconCite|54|Starship Fact File}} Soon afterward, with the Queen in his custody, the Viceroy met with OOM-9 within the royal palace and commanded his droid officer to select a handful of [[OOM-series security droid]]s to ensure the transfer of Amidala and her entourage to an imprisonment camp on the surface. The droid commander then called upon a nearby OOM-series security droid captain to follow the Viceroy's instructions. As OOM-9 delegated the mission, the droid officer left the company of his subordinate battle droids, which saved him from destruction as the Queen and her fellow Naboo were rescued by the escaped Jinn and Kenobi, who escorted Amidala off-world to the Republic capital world of Coruscant, to appeal her case to the Republic Senate in hopes of their interference in the Federation's illegal occupation. ===Searching for the Gungans=== {{Quote|My troops are in position to begin searching the swamps for these rumored underwater villages. They will not stay hidden for long.|OOM-9, reporting his mission to locate the Gungan cities to Gunray|}} [[File:OOM9Reporting-TPM.png|thumb|right|300px|OOM-9 speaking to Viceroy Gunray on his search for the Gungan cities.]] Days into the Federation's occupation, OOM-9 began to gather information regarding the existence of alleged cities located [[Water|underwater]], inhabited by the planet's native [[Gungan]] [[species]]. Acting upon these rumors, the droid commander reported his mission to the Viceroy and sent his battle droids into position to begin scouring the Naboo [[swamp]]s in search of the hidden cities. In their searches, the droid army discovered many Gungan cities, including the small city of [[Otoh Langua]] and the Gungan capital of [[Otoh Gunga]], which led to their subsequent assaults.''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' Prior to the arrival of OOM-9's forces, the citizens of Otoh Gunga received warnings of the droid army's approach on the city. In alert to the coming droid forces, the Gungan inhabitants evacuated from Otoh Gunga to a [[Gungan Sacred Place|hidden sanctuary]] within the swamps on the surface. At the same time, the droid forces fought against the [[Militiagung]] warriors of Otoh Langua, chasing the inhabitants from the city to the Gungan Sacred Palace alongside the citizens of several other cities during their attacks. In the aftermath of the attacks, OOM-9 and his forces succeeded in securing control over the entire planet, as well as its inhabitants. However, despite the Federation's successes, Darth Sidious dispatched his Sith apprentice, [[Maul|Darth Maul]], to Naboo in order to observe the situation. Meanwhile, OOM-9's forces found resistance from an [[Naboo resistance|underground movement]] of Naboo personnel, including hundreds of police and guards from the Royal Security Forces. ===The Battle of Naboo=== {{Quote|She is more foolish than I thought.''"
"''We are sending all troops to meet this army assembling near the swamp. It appears to be made up of primitives.''"
"''This will work to our advantage.''"
"''I have your approval to proceed, then, my lord?''"
"''Wipe them out. All of them.|Nute Gunray and Darth Sidious, on the Gungan Grand Army's assembly|}} Following the Federation's capture of Naboo, Queen Amidala returned to the Mid Rim world in response to her unsuccessful pleas for assistance from the Republic Senate on Coruscant. As a result, the monarch desired to handle the Federation's invasion herself, which led to her enlistment of [[Boss]] [[Rugor Nass]] and the [[Gungan High Council]]'s [[Gungan Grand Army|Grand Army]] in a [[Battle of Naboo|decisive engagement]] to reclaim their homeworld from the Federation. However, while they plead for the Gungans to aid their efforts, OOM-9 dispatched patrols across Naboo and discovered the Queen's return to the planet and her presence within the Naboo swamps. As Amidala and her forces planned their counterattack against the Federation forces, the Gungan Grand Army was ordered to the [[Great Grass Plains]] in an effort to lure out OOM-9 and the bulk of the Trade Federation Droid Army, while the Queen captured Gunray within the Royal Palace and the Droid Control Ship, ''Vuutun Palaa'', was destroyed by the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]]. Assembling near the swamps in the grassy fields, Gunray dispatched OOM-9 and the Federation army to engage the Gungan army, with orders from Sidious to exterminate the entirety of the Gungans. Protected by [[deflector shield generator]]s activated by [[Captain]] [[Roos Tarpals]], OOM-9's forces of Armored Assault Tanks and [[Multi-Troop Transport]]s descended upon the valley from the nearby hills, where the droid commander ordered a preliminary bombardment against the [[deflector shield]]s after observing them through his [[electrobinoculars]], without success. After a while, the command battle droid ended the bombardment and ordered the tanks to draw back, allowing the Multi-Troop Transports to deploy thousands of inactive B1 battle droids upon the grassy fields. Activated by the Neimoidian pilot [[Tey How]] in orbit, the battle droids began their march through the Gungan's shields, which was initally expected to not be possible by the Gungans. With the Battle of Naboo commenced, the thousands of battle droids fired upon the unarmed militiagungs, but were subsequently attacked by the Gungans under the leadership of [[Bombad General]] [[Jar Jar Binks]] and Captain Tarpals. In a counterattack to the Gungan's offensive, OOM-9 deployed several [[droideka]]s onto the battlefield, leading to heavier Gungan casualties. After destroying the deflector shield from concentrated droideka [[blaster]] fire, the droid commander ordered the standby Armored Assault Tanks to attack the Gungans as they began their retreat.However, OOM-9 would be deactivated when [[Anakin Skywalker]] destroyed the Droid Control ship. ==Personality and traits== An OOM command battle droid, OOM-9 stood at 1.91 [[meter]]s in height. He had two [[Color|black]]-colored [[sensor]]s, as well as [[bone]]-white plating with patterns of yellow markings across his body shared by other OOM command battle droids, to indicate his rank of [[commander]]. Similarly to the [[B1-series battle droid]]s of the Trade Federation Droid Army, OOM-9 was incapable of harboring independent thoughts, as he received instructions and commands from the [[Central Control Computer]] of a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|''Lucrehulk''-class Battleship]]. In spite of his dependence to a central source, the droid commander was specifically programmed to operate as the commanding officer for the Federation's droid forces during the Invasion of Naboo, in which he served to accomplish assignments presented to him by his commanders, Nute Gunray and Rune Haako. ==Equipment== While in command of the Trade Federation's battle droids, OOM-9 operated within his personalized [[Armored Assault Tank Mk I]]. In addition, the droid commander possessed a pair of [[electrobinoculars]], which he utilized to observe engagements from distances during the invasions, as well as two [[antenna]]e on his back, from which he communicated to Gunray and Haako. He also communicated through a [[vocabulator]]. ==Behind the scenes== While ''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' states that OOM command battle droids and other [[OOM-series battle droid]]s are predecessors to the [[B1-series battle droid]] line,''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' ''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' and ''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' state that OOM-9 is a B1. Because both ''Ultimate Star Wars'' books and the majority of other [[canon]] sources treat OOM units as part of the B1 line,''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]''''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''''[[Star Wars: Droidography]]'' this article assumes ''The Complete Visual Dictionary'' is incorrect. ==Appearances== *{{Film|I}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Star Wars: The Phantom Menace'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[William Shakespeare's The Phantom of Menace: Star Wars Part the First]]'' *''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' ==Sources== *{{SWE|characters|nutegunray|Nute Gunray}} *''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' *{{HelmetCollectionCite|42|Databank A-Z}} *''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' {{CardGameSet|set={{ForceCollection|parent=1}} {{1stID|OOM-9|''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' OOM-9 three star card and OOM-9|''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' OOM-9 one star card}}|cards= *{{ForceCollection|OOM-9|star=1}} *{{ForceCollection|OOM-9|star=3}} }} *''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' *''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' *{{EncyclopediaCite|Battle Droids and Other Droids of War}} *''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|aat-battle-tank|AAT Battle Tank}} {{Po}} *{{Databank|battle-droid|Battle Droid}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=OOM-9 |fr=OOM-9 |ja=OOM-9 |ko=OOM-9 |pl=OOM-9 |tr=OOM-9 }} [[Category:Droids of the Trade Federation]] [[Category:Droids with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Droids with unspecified gender programming]] [[Category:OOM command battle droids]]
